name: Niv-Mizzet
description: Niv-Mizzet is the dragon guildmaster of the Izzet League on Ravnica, known as the Firemind and, after his rebirth, the Living Guildpact.

summary.text: Niv-Mizzet is the dragon guildmaster of the Izzet League on Ravnica, known as the Firemind and, after his rebirth, the Living Guildpact.

bio.text: As head of the Izzet League he oversaw Project Lightning Bug, sided with Maree, ordered more power for the storm amplifier, and then terminated the project as unreliable.

citations.text: "Project Lightning Bug" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 May 2015.

bio.text: During the War of the Spark he was dead, and Operation Desperation placed the Firemind's Vessel on his bones.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Maree suggests tracking Jace's long disappearances and Ral is appointed Head Researcher of Project Lightning Bug.
timeline.quote: Thus Ral had been appointed Head Researcher of a project to record and explain Beleren's disappearances.

citation.work: Project Lightning Bug
citation.text: "Project Lightning Bug" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Flashback: At Izzet headquarters Maree reveals she has replicated the detectors and found two new Planeswalker signals, threatening Ral's secret.
timeline.quote: other Planeswalkers coming and going from Ravnica.

citation.work: Project Lightning Bug
citation.text: "Project Lightning Bug" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet sides with Maree and orders more power added to the storm amplifier.
timeline.quote: Finally he looked at Maree. "Do it."

citation.work: Project Lightning Bug
citation.text: "Project Lightning Bug" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet declares the method unreliable and terminates Project Lightning Bug.
timeline.quote: "Project terminated," snarled the dragon

citation.work: Project Lightning Bug
citation.text: "Project Lightning Bug" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Vraska sees Jace's memory of becoming the Living Guildpact at the Forum of Azor.
timeline.quote: It was the day Jace became the Living Guildpact.

citation.work: The Race, Part 2
citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: They choose Niv-Mizzet as the one to help devise the plan.
timeline.quote: He could challenge Nicol Bolas both physically and mentally

citation.work: Sabotage
citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Rat meets her friend Hekara on the Transguild Promenade and reports on tailing Ral Zarek to Nivix, where he and Niv-Mizzet had an exploding experiment.
timeline.quote: Something about a beacon being their only chance now.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat learns Domri Rade is dead after his Spark was harvested and that Niv-Mizzet is dead.
timeline.quote: Turns out he was a Planeswalker and got his Spark harvested by an Eternal.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Zarek and Maree discuss Operation Desperation, requiring all ten guilds.
timeline.quote: you'll need cooperation from ten of ten guilds. There can be no exceptions.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Representatives gather at the ruins of the Embassy of the Guildpact; Rat explains Operation Desperation and the Firemind's Vessel placed on Niv-Mizzet's bones.
timeline.quote: Chief Varryvort gently placed the Vessel atop Master Niv-Mizzet's blackened bones.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Operation Desperation activates and Niv-Mizzet's bones ignite; the light draws a God-Eternal.
timeline.quote: it had attracted the attention of one of the God-Eternals

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet is reborn with golden scales and a decagon seared into his chest.
timeline.quote: And then Master Niv-Mizzet was reborn, with scales of shiny gold

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet severs the God-Eternal's fist and burns it away with his breath.
timeline.quote: An unending torrent of flame engulfed the God-Eternal

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet crashes to the ground, barely moving, shattering the group's hopes.
timeline.quote: The dragon crashed down ten feet to the left of us, shaking the ground—and shattering all our hopes.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet stabs Bolas with the Spear of Hazoret but is thrown aside.
timeline.quote: Hovering behind him and holding the spear was Master Niv-Mizzet

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet tells Jace the Firemind is the new Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: The Firemind is the new Living Guildpact.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: The guilds assign Zarek to hunt Tezzeret, Vraska to hunt Dovin Baan, and hire Kaya to assassinate Liliana.
timeline.quote: And Kaya, the ten guilds wish to hire you to assassinate Liliana Vess.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Proft and Etrata enter Niv-Mizzet's chamber for an appointment that was hard to obtain.
timeline.quote: Proft's footsteps echoed as he walked into the chamber currently occupied by Niv-Mizzet, the Firemind and Living Guildpact.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2024.

timeline.summary: Proft asks how Niv-Mizzet could fail to notice Trostani's use of Ravnica to kill, and the dragon says he was otherwise occupied.
timeline.quote: "I was otherwise occupied," said Niv-Mizzet, somewhat stiffly.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2024.

timeline.summary: Proft raises Kylox's project, and reasons that Niv-Mizzet stood back because he was working on something larger than a few murders.
timeline.quote: the only reason you would stand back was because you were working on something bigger.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2024.

timeline.summary: Proft reveals he decoded Kylox's cryptex and knows about the Omenpath Project.
timeline.quote: I know about the Omenpath Project.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2024.

timeline.summary: Proft explains that rifts called Omenpaths opened across the planes after the invasion, and Niv-Mizzet says they are natural to Kaldheim.
timeline.quote: A phenomenon natural to the plane of Kaldheim.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2024.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet explains the Omenpaths are his responsibility as Living Guildpact, as they could be used to exploit security gaps or smuggle goods.
timeline.quote: As Living Guildpact, they're my responsibility.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2024.

timeline.summary: Proft deduces that Niv-Mizzet plans to make Ravnica the hub of the connected Multiverse, and Niv-Mizzet confirms it.
timeline.quote: "Yes," said Niv-Mizzet simply.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2024.

timeline.summary: Proft offers his and Etrata's services to Niv-Mizzet, who is surprised and admits the deductive skills would be welcome.
timeline.quote: Your deductive skills would not be unwelcome,

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2024.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer says she traced the door's echo through the Omenpaths to Ravnica, where Niv-Mizzet guards it.
timeline.quote: I found it on Ravnica, being guarded by Niv-Mizzet.

citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Zimone leads the group to a courtyard where Kaito presents Tyvar and Niko to the dragon Niv-Mizzet.
timeline.quote: The alley ended in a small courtyard, dominated by a massive red dragon lounging on the far side like a cat

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet reveals that a girl called Aminatou has already arrived, saying the team will need her help; Niko recognizes the name.
timeline.quote: A young girl, younger than Zimone here, who calls herself Aminatou.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The door slams shut behind the team as Aminatou, Etrata, Proft and Niv-Mizzet watch.
timeline.quote: Then the door closed, and the House was all.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaito tells Niv-Mizzet that Jace left him.
timeline.quote: He said he was sorry, and he left me.
